description: Email inboxes and shared cloud files for people and AI agents. Use Revdoku to receive and read messages and attachments, upload selected local files, and write, restore, or organize stored files. Also supports bucket archiving, permanent bucket deletion, and agency client account creation when explicitly requested and authorized. Email is receive-only; storage supports reads and writes.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
